text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dura-san, happy birthday! So... about that 
birthday race I sent on LANE, will you 
accept my challenge?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Show me a speed that can threaten 
me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Dia-chan helped me out too, so 
I made sure it's in tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. I have heard much about your 
accomplishments."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Defeating you now that you've grown 
stronger brings me one step closer to 
becoming the "strongest." ...It will add 
to my renown as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then you'd want a huge crowd to see it, 
right? Thinking just that, I've already 
invited everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Races are best when they're a huge 
festival! But I won't just hand you an 
easy 'win'!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...That festive uproar will soon turn 
into cheers for me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I shall accept those cheers as my 
celebration.
